Julie (Events): Quick sync — need to lock plan for the London evening satellite: booth, speaker slots, swag counts, and lead routing from the afterparty sign-up. Deadline: EOD Tue.
Sam G (Growth): Confirming lead routing: evening QR should go to a HubSpot form (utm=ldn-evening). Capture email + company + interest area?
Julie (Events): Yes 13 email, company, interest area (integration / cost / eval). Keep it mobile friendly.
Miguel (Design): On QR + landing hero. Any brand do/don'ts for the flyer?
Tara (Content): Use the new product blurb: "Redwood: predictable LLM inference at scale" + CTA "Request demo & benchmark". I'll do microcopy for the landing page.
Adrian (Ops): Booth tech checklist: 1 demo laptop (NUC backup), 1 4G hotspot, HDMI, power strip, extension, surge protector. Need small table for live demo and schedule sign.
Loren (Logistics): Swag vendor quote in: recommend counts: 350 stickers, 150 tees, 120 bottles, 80 enamel pins, 40 totes. Print ETA 12 business days if we approve by Fri.
Sam G (Growth): Nurture flow: Day0 immediate email + calendar link; Day3 benchmark whitepaper; Day10 invite to webinar. Will build in flow.
Julie (Events): Tee size split proposal: S20 M60 L45 XL20 XXL5. Any objections?
Miguel (Design): XXL needs logo scale tweak. I'll export print-ready files today.
Tara (Content): Drafting 30s demo script for speaker slot — show latency + cost comparison, 2-query demo vs unoptimized. Will post for review.
Loren (Logistics): Vendor needs shipping address and PO by Thu. Shipping address:
```
Redwood Inference - Events
Attn: Loren / Julie
Unit 4, Shoreline Studios
12 Dockside Walk
London, E16 2BX
```
Loren (Logistics): Vendor pickup in 2 business days after proof approval.
Adrian (Ops): Booth network: request wired ethernet; fallback hotspot + local cache. Pin demo model to avoid cold starts: `model: r-3b-quant@v2`.
Sam G (Growth): Speakers: who is confirmed? Need bios to submit by Wed.
Julie (Events): Confirmed: Julie taking 10-min lightning + Q&A. Miguel tentative for visual walkthrough. Tara finalize 2-3 line bios.
Tara (Content): Draft bios: "Julie: Head of Events, Redwood — runs infra & partner programs." "Miguel: Product Designer, Redwood — builds UX for inference observability." Please edit.
Shippo Bot: Shipment created: ORDER#RDW-2026-559, ETA 2026-05-14, tracking: https://shippo.example/track/RDW-2026-559
Loren (Logistics): Shippo shows vendor pickup in 2 business days if we approve proofs.
Sam G (Growth): Lead routing detail: QR -> landing (utm=ldn-evening) -> HubSpot form -> tag `ldn-evening-2026` -> nurture flow. I will also accept Meetup CSV imports if needed.
Julie (Events): Action list: Miguel export print files today; Tara finalize bios + landing copy tomorrow; Sam finalize HubSpot form + flow tomorrow; Loren approve PO + schedule pickup by Thu; Adrian pin demo model + prepare hotspot by Thu. I'll send walk-through calendar invite Thu 10am BST. :spiral_calendar:
Sam G (Growth): Badge scanner? If QR -> HubSpot form we can avoid scanner. Simpler.
Miguel (Design): Uploading QR variations (color & b/w) to assets, print & digital versions.
Tara (Content): Drafting immediate subject line: "Great meeting you at the Redwood evening — demo & benchmark" + 1-line preview.
Julie (Events): Thanks everyone — ping if you can't hit deadlines. :tada:
